name: Comfort UI
author: Local UI Workshop
description:
Comfort UI 0.6.3: fixes the reported keyboard closing/stranded bottom strip, blocked gameplay, PC centering and Chinese/Japanese/Korean control-label problems. The reporting user confirmed the repair on their PC. Upgrade from affected 0.6.0–0.6.2 releases. The same tested DLL/EXE are published; their earlier test labels remain.

Configurable 13-language interface and original-layout in-game keyboard, local word suggestions, Chinese pinyin, Japanese romaji/common kanji and Korean Hangul composition. Desktop Windows IME/Win+H uses a child of the game window without a separate input dialog. Appropriate Windows components are required. Other devices, broader Cohtml/IME/Win+H/VR and long sessions remain unverified.

Includes cumulative menu, camera, microphone, chat bubble, nameplate, animation and translation bridge fixes. Typed JSON events, explicit escaping, strict session checks and plain-text rendering are retained. Preferences and local model caches are preserved.

[Installer](https://github.com/xuan5636/ChilloutVR-ComfortUI/releases/download/v0.6.3/ComfortUI-Setup-0.6.3.exe) | [Keyboard guide](https://github.com/xuan5636/ChilloutVR-ComfortUI/blob/v0.6.3/docs/KEYBOARD.md) | [Release/feedback](https://github.com/xuan5636/ChilloutVR-ComfortUI/releases/tag/v0.6.3)

Online translation is opt-in and sends selected/visible text to the chosen provider. Suggestions stay local. Word data retains separate CC BY-SA/MIT/Apache notices. Unofficial mod, not affiliated with, approved, verified or supported by ChilloutVR or Alpha Blend Interactive. Modifications may affect performance, security or stability.
requirements: Windows x64 and .NET Framework 4.8; local model download is optional. See repository installation and translation documentation.
changelog: 0.6.3 keyboard fixes: completes native close and input/cursor unlock; removes the leftover bottom strip; synchronizes close/submit/hide and PC menu cancellation; fixes PC centering and CJK control-label fonts. The reporting user confirmed the fix on their PC. 1052 managed, 75 keyboard-engine, 637 typed-event and 64 offline UI checks passed. Preferences/model caches retained; broader IME/Win+H/VR remains unverified.
